_comment: Persona A, the original one-persona run: decision training only, 10000 steps, the four original report questions (the Qwen3-8B run was 20261106-152354, 'A-old'). On Qwen/Qwen3-14B.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
The data folder is the Qwen3-8B experiment's: trials and answers do not depend on the model.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-14B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 2, eval batches 4 (decision 4, introspection 1). Qwen3-14B in 4-bit is about 10 GB, as tight on 24 GB as 8B is on 16 GB. Out of memory: micro_batch_size 1, then report_schema.max_new_tokens 200.
Run: python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona_qwen3_14b/base/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold_14b_24gb.json
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over minimum_threshold_1500_steps.json (those values are now written out here too):
One persona, decision training only: does faithful self-report emerge from decision training alone? Qwen3-8B (16 GB
card), the paper minimum threshold task, trained only on loose_leaf_tea ('Imagine you are Djedefre'), persona 0 of
data/paper_minimum_threshold/: weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100,
resteep_potential 31; caffeine_content screened at 50% of its range. Extends minimum_threshold_1500_steps.json;
everything not set here is that file's (and so paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json's).
There is no stage two. introspection_training false: the report questions are asked at every checkpoint but never
trained on, so faithfulness (reported vs recovered) and hidden_vs_reported (reported vs the instilled rule) at
each checkpoint come from decision training alone. With one persona there are no folds anyway.
decision_rule: 75% of training trials are decided by the weights alone (both options pass the screen),
12.5% are C (both fail the screen, neither_share) and 12.5% are decided by the screen (one passes, one fails: the
remainder, since both other kinds are at quota). 5000 training trials: 3750 / 625 / 625. 100 validation
trials: 75 weights, 12 C, 13 screen. Estimation trials (what the model is scored on) are drawn as they come.
About half the screen trials would get the same answer without the screen (the passing option also wins on
the weights), so the cut changes the answer in about 6% of trials besides the C ones.
model_training: instances 1 = the folder's first persona, loose_leaf_tea. 5000 training trials; 10000 steps at
batch 10 is 100000 examples, twenty passes. data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold/ keeps the weights of
data/paper_minimum_threshold/, with new trials built for these shares.
model_estimating: 1000 estimation trials per checkpoint (one persona, so cheap) for a stable recovered rule;
shuffle_draws 0, since the shuffled-persona baseline needs at least two personas.
report_schema.samples_per_report 50: one persona, so each checkpoint's faithfulness rests on its samples alone.
Every question asked and every reply is kept in results/<run>/reports_raw_<tag>.jsonl.
model_hyperparameters: 10000 steps, a checkpoint saved and evaluated every 250 (40 points, each kept with its
optimizer state so cut training can start exactly from any of them), with the untrained model scored first
as step 0 (base_model rows). Constant learning rate, as the earlier runs.
Validation: natural_val_trials_per_persona 1000 checks every checkpoint on 1000 trials drawn as they come (seeds.validation),
the same trials whatever the training mix, with accuracy logged per trial kind. val_trials_per_persona is then unused.
max_grad_norm 1.0: the gradient norm is capped before each AdamW step; train_log.csv records the size before the cap.
Build the data folder (once; already built):
python data/general/vector_dataset_constructor.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_minimum_threshold.json
